top_signals.title: Bally’s Warns of Debt Covenant Breach Risk As It Seeks New Funds
top_signals.summary: Bally’s Corp. warned investors of “substantial doubt” that it will be able to continue as a going concern as the company risks running afoul of agreement with lenders.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
